Name: Complete Community Center Bundles for SVE and RSV
Author: stardustshinki
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[quote][color=#D4D4D8]Based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Nahlbrii]Nahlbrii[/url]'s " [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26998][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26998]Completionist's Complete Community Center (All Bundles) (Multi Language Support)[/url] ," this mod completely overhauls the Community Center bundles by integrating content from Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) and Ridgeside Village (RSV).[/color][/quote]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Full SVE & RSV Integration[/b]: All bundles have been redesigned to include crops, foraged items, fish, artisan goods, and other resources from both mods.[/*]
[*][b]All Bundles Enabled[/b]: Every Community Center bundle is active and available.[/*]
[*][b]Complete Submission Required[/b]: All items in a bundle must be fully submitted before it can be completed ( partial submissions are not allowed ) .[/*]
[*][b]Comprehensive & Challenging[/b]: Offers a more engaging and complex experience than vanilla bundles, encouraging you to explore all the new content SVE and RSV have to offer.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][b]Install Requirements[/b]: Ensure you have the latest versions of SMAPI, Content Patcher, SVE, and RSV installed correctly.[/*]
[*][b]Download the Mod[/b]: Download this mod from the "Files" tab.[/*]
[*][b]Extract the File[/b]: Unzip the downloaded folder.[/*]
[*][b]Move to Mods Folder[/b]: Place the extracted folder "CCCBFSR" into your "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder.[/*]
[*][b]Run the Game[/b]: Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI. The new bundles will be active in a new save file.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod requires the following to function:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][url=https://smapi.io/][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/b]: The mod loader for Stardew Valley.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/b]: The framework for loading content packs.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/url][/b]: The expansive content mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village (RSV)[/url][/b]: The custom village and NPC expansion.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url], for Content Patcher and SMAPI.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/FlashShifter]FlashShifter[/url], for Stardew Valley Expanded.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Rafseazz]Rafseazz[/url], for the Ridgeside Village mod.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Nahlbrii][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Nahlbrii][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Nahlbrii]Nahlbrii[/url], whose "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26998]Completionist's Complete Community Center[/url]" bundle expansion served as a great reference.[/*]
[*]The entire Stardew Valley modding community, for their creativity and support.[/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
Item counts match the vanilla.
Use only on a new save. Do not activate on existing saves (may corrupt data).
Do not enable "Remixed Bundles" with this mod (causes conflicts).
